grades: Enrolled in high school (classes of 2027 to 2030)
duration: 6 to 8 weeks, about 20 to 30 hours a week, plus 3 required training events
pay_detail: Seattle's minimum wage (projected $21.81 an hour in 2027), up to 160 hours, so up to about $3,300
name: TIPS Summer Internship
what_you_do: Work part time at a local nonprofit for the summer. TIPS hires you and places you based on your interests, such as a camp, an arts group or a food bank.
who_can_apply: Teens who are 15 or older by May 19, 2027, not older than 19 during the program, enrolled in high school, with a Washington address and proof of US work eligibility.
deadline_text: Applications open mid to late November 2026 (exact day not posted). Deadline Feb 5, 2027. Interviews early to mid March, decisions April 2027.
how_to_apply: Create an account on Submittable, answer short questions, and get two letters of recommendation. Top applicants get a virtual interview.
notes: Washington requires a signed parent and school authorization form for every worker under 18 (L&I page). Competitive and interviews are not guaranteed. TIPS pays you, not the nonprofit. Free ORCA transit cards for youth up to 18 are mentioned on the page.
